exportFileTip.message: The web page file can be opened directly to view and click the links; the full backup file contains everything and can be used to restore your data.

importBackupTip.message: Choose a .json file saved earlier with Export full backup. Importing appends and merges: it will not overwrite your existing tabs, and collection times and other info in the backup are kept as they are.

webdavPassTip.message: Note: your password is only stored in this browser on this computer. It is only used to sign in to your own WebDAV server and is never sent anywhere else. After filling in the address, username and password, click Save options below first, then you can upload or restore.

webdavConfigMissing.message: Please fill in the WebDAV server address first (and click Save options after filling it in).

webdavUploadSuccess.message: Upload succeeded, the backup is now stored on WebDAV.

webdavUploadFailed.message: Upload failed, and your local data was not changed. Please check the server address, username, password and network, then try again. Details:

webdavRestoreConfirm.message: Restoring will replace all your current tabs and recycle bin contents with the backup on WebDAV. Before replacing, your current data will automatically be saved as a snapshot on this computer, so you can get it back if anything goes wrong. Are you sure you want to restore?

webdavRestoreSuccess.message: Restore finished, the page will reload.

webdavRestoreFailed.message: Restore failed, and your current local data was not changed. Details:
